one_liner: Git-based code hosting platform with issues, pull requests, Actions CI/CD, and a REST/GraphQL API.

auth.evidence_quote: You can also create an OAuth token with an OAuth app to access the REST API.
auth.notes: GitHub calls its tokens 'personal access tokens', not 'API keys', so bearer_token fits better than api_key. GitHub Apps authenticate with a JWT then exchange for installation tokens; recommended path for building for other accounts is OAuth via a GitHub App or OAuth App.

access.evidence_quote: You can create a personal access token
access.notes: Free GitHub account gets a working PAT immediately; public OAuth/GitHub Apps do not require GitHub's approval to be installed on arbitrary accounts (user just authorizes). Extra-gate confidence lowered since this specific claim wasn't directly quoted from a page.

api.notes: GitHub REST API reference spans hundreds of endpoints across many resource categories (repos, issues, actions, packages, etc.), well over the 'broad' (>100) threshold based on well-known docs structure; endpoint_count not counted precisely this pass.

verdict.rationale: Free account, OAuth2 or PAT auth, broad REST/GraphQL API, and an official MCP server make this immediately buildable.
